meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: Claude 会从 channels 分支复制 Telegram 适配器及配对、markdown 清理辅助文件与测试，注册适配器、安装 @chat-adapter/telegram 依赖并构建验证；再引导你创建 bot、填入 token、重启服务，用 4 位数字完成配对。
howto.when: 在你要给项目添加 Telegram 频道支持时触发；通常发生在 /setup 流程中，或用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 接入频道时。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Telegram 支持
say.note: 复制适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试

say.text: 帮我创建 Telegram bot 并配上 token
运行 Telegram 配对步骤
say.note: 打印 4 位验证码，你从目标聊天发给 bot

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Telegram adapter and its helpers (with tests) from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/telegram, builds, then guides bot creation, token setup, a restart and a 4-digit pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Telegram channel support to a project: during /setup, or afterwards via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Telegram support to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, builds, runs the test

say_en.text: Help me create a Telegram bot and set the token
say_en.note: Guides you through @BotFather and validates the token
Prints a 4-digit code to send to the bot from your chat
